question: Which of the following institutions has been accredited as a National Implementing Entity for Adaptation Fund under United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NABARD.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NABARD **is the **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development.**
 
• It has been accredited as the **National Implementing Entity for Adaptation Fund** under **United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change** (UNFCCC) in India.
 
• The Adaptation Fund was established under the** Kyoto Protocol of the UNFCCC** to finance concrete adaptation projects and programmes in developing countries that are parties to the Protocol.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ICAR** is the Indian Council of Agricultural Research.

 
 
• It is a premier research institution in the field of **agriculture and allied sciences **in India. 
 
 
 
• **NIRD **is the National Institute of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj.
 
 
• It is an Indian institute for research in** rural development, l**ocated in Hyderabad, Telangana.
 
 
 
• **RBI** is Reserve Bank of India.
 
 
• It is India's central bank, responsible for the** issue and supply of the Indian rupee** and the regulation of the Indian banking system.
